extracted.name: Lemon & rhubarb rice pudding
extracted.description: Infuse traditional rice pudding with lemon curd and rhubarb for a zesty yet comforting dessert. It's a real treat on a cold day
ingredient_lines: 1 chopped ball of stem ginger in syrup
instruction_lines: Put the pudding rice in a pan with the milk and caster sugar and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 40-45 mins, or until the rice is tender, stirring often to ensure it doesn’t catch on the bottom.

Meanwhile, cut the rhubarb into 3cm pieces and put in a pan with the caster sugar, stem ginger and the syrup. Bring to a simmer and cook for 7-10 mins, or until the rhubarb is soft but still holds its shape.
Stir the double cream and lemon curd through the rice pudding, then top with some of the poached rhubarb.
